legalPrivacy.title: Privacy policy
legalPrivacy.intro: This policy describes how VZV GROUP s.r.o. processes personal data of visitors to noblelift.cz and persons who contact us regarding the offer, sale, service and distribution of Noblelift material handling equipment.

sections.title: Data controller
paragraphs: The data controller is VZV GROUP s.r.o., registered office Okružní 1144, 500 03 Hradec Králové, Czech Republic, Company ID 27469662, VAT ID CZ27469662, registered in the Commercial Register maintained by the Regional Court in Hradec Králové, file no. C 20857 (the “controller”).
Contact e-mail for privacy matters: info@noblelift.cz.

sections.title: Categories of data processed
paragraphs: We mainly process the following categories of personal data:
list: identification and contact details (name, e-mail, phone, company, country)
content of contact form messages or e-mail communication
inquiry, order, service or complaint data
technical website usage data (IP address, browser type, cookies – see our Cookie policy)

sections.title: Purposes and legal bases
paragraphs: We process personal data only for defined purposes and on the relevant legal basis under GDPR Article 6:
list: handling inquiries and communication – legitimate interest / steps prior to contract
contract performance, delivery, service and warranty care – contract
compliance with legal obligations (accounting, tax, archiving) – legal obligation
website security and operation – legitimate interest
marketing communication – only with your consent, which you may withdraw at any time

sections.title: Retention period
paragraphs: We retain data for as long as necessary for the processing purpose. Inquiries and business communication are usually kept for 3 years from the last contact unless a contractual relationship is established. Contract data is kept for the duration of the contract and thereafter as required by law (typically 10 years for accounting and tax). Technical logs and cookies are retained for the periods stated in the cookie information.

sections.title: Recipients and processors
paragraphs: Personal data may be disclosed to IT, hosting, e-mail, accounting and other processors who perform these activities for us under a data processing agreement. We do not share data with third parties for their own marketing without your consent.
Some processors may be located outside the European Union; in such cases we ensure appropriate transfer safeguards under the GDPR.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Under the GDPR you have the right to:
list: request access to your personal data
request rectification or erasure
request restriction of processing
object to processing
request data portability
withdraw consent where processing is based on consent
lodge a complaint with the Czech Office for Personal Data Protection (www.uoou.cz)

sections.title: Data security
paragraphs: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against loss, misuse, unauthorised access or disclosure.

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: Detailed information on cookies is available on the Cookies page. Optional analytics cookies are enabled only with your consent via the cookie banner.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time. The current version is always published on this website with the effective date.

legalCookies.title: Cookie policy
legalCookies.intro: This page explains how noblelift.cz, operated by VZV GROUP s.r.o., uses cookies and similar technologies.

sections.title: What are cookies
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files stored in your browser. They help the website function correctly, remember your choices or measure traffic.

sections.title: Essential cookies
paragraphs: These cookies are required for basic website functions. Without them the site may not work properly. We do not need your consent for these cookies.
list: NEXT_LOCALE – stores your selected website language (cs/en)
noblelift-cookie-consent – stores your cookie choice in the browser

sections.title: Analytics and marketing cookies
paragraphs: Optional cookies for traffic measurement or marketing are used only if you consent via the cookie banner. If you do not consent, we do not enable them.
At present the website primarily uses essential cookies. Any addition of analytics tools (e.g. Google Analytics) will always require your consent and this page will be updated accordingly.

sections.title: Managing cookies
paragraphs: You can change your preferences at any time via the Cookie settings link in the website footer or by deleting cookies in your browser.
In the cookie banner you can choose Reject all, Accept all, or open Settings to enable individual categories. Optional categories remain off until you turn them on.
If your browser blocks all cookies, some website features may be unavailable.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: For cookie-related questions contact info@noblelift.cz. Further information on personal data processing is available in our Privacy policy.

walkieHub.badge: Without initial lift / With initial lift
walkieHub.title: Walkie stackers without operator platform
walkieHub.intro: An efficient solution for warehouses that prioritise maximum compactness and easy operation. Electric walkie stackers without a platform are designed for precise handling in narrow aisles and space-constrained operations. They are ideal for loading, unloading and stacking pallets over short distances where agility, accuracy and efficient work in a limited handling area are key.

riderHub.badge: Without initial lift / With initial lift
riderHub.title: Stackers with operator platform
riderHub.intro: An efficient solution for larger warehouses and operations with longer travel distances between racks. Electric rider stackers with an operator platform offer more comfortable operation, higher lift and faster pallet handling in warehouse aisles. The operator stands on the platform and travels with the truck between work locations, improving productivity when stacking, unloading and replenishing goods.

2.intro: Looking for a simple and cost-effective solution for pallet handling? Manually guided stackers are ideal for smaller warehouses, workshops and large logistics operations. fe4d16.subtitle: Series A electric counterbalance forklift, 1,600 kg capacity
fe4d16.longDesc: The FE4D16N belongs to Series A — a reliable Noblelift electric counterbalance forklift with lithium battery for standard warehouse operations. It offers compact dimensions, efficient AC drive with regenerative braking and simple controls suited to everyday pallet handling in distribution, manufacturing and retail warehouses.

fe4d18.subtitle: Series A electric counterbalance forklift, 1,800 kg capacity
fe4d18.longDesc: The FE4D18N is a four-wheel Series A electric counterbalance forklift with 1,800 kg capacity. With lithium battery and AC drive it handles intensive warehouse and production floor operations. Its compact design enables efficient handling in confined spaces while maintaining high stability and operator safety.

fe4d20.subtitle: Series A electric counterbalance forklift, 2,000 kg capacity
fe4d20.longDesc: The FE4D20N is a versatile Series A electric counterbalance forklift with 2,000 kg capacity. Suited to medium-duty warehouse operations where performance, reliability and low running costs matter. The lithium battery enables fast charging and long service life with minimal maintenance.

fe4d25.subtitle: Series A electric counterbalance forklift, 2,500 kg capacity
fe4d25.longDesc: The FE4D25N is the most capable Series A model in the range with 2,500 kg capacity. Designed for more demanding operations requiring higher lift capacity and stability when handling heavier pallets. AC drive, lithium battery and robust construction ensure reliable operation even in multi-shift use.
